Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Configure mandatory artifacts for your lab

Body.Content:
As a lab owner, you can now set a list of mandatory artifacts that will be applied on every machine created within your lab. This will save your lab users the effort of adding such "must have" artifacts when they create a new lab machine.

To learn more about how this feature works, go to our team blog.
